exploit_name: Oracle data corruption via storage key collision between Counts and Snapshot structs
description: Storage key derivation allows collisions between Counts and Snapshot structs when token addresses have specific properties.
root_cause: Storage key derivation allows collisions between Counts and Snapshot structs when token addresses have specific properties.
fix_description: Use distinct storage namespaces or add type discriminators to storage key derivation.
notes: Oracle data becomes corrupted, leading to incorrect price reads and downstream protocol failures.
